<br>

## What this manual covers

The Technical Manual is the practical how-to guide for the BNR analytics and publishing environment **after data have been collected in REDCap**.

Use it to run analytical workflows, review and approve outputs, publish controlled releases, maintain the Info-Hub website, make safe code changes and diagnose common problems.

It is designed for **dip-in, dip-out use**. Find the task you need, follow the steps and complete the human checks before moving on.

## The three BNR manuals

| Manual | Main purpose |
|---|---|
| **Technical Manual** | Operate and maintain the post-REDCap analytics, release and publishing environment. |
| **[Operations Manual](../operations/index.qmd)** | Registry operating procedures before and within REDCap, including data collection, governance and routine registry operation. |
| **[Public Methods Manual](../methods/index.qmd)** | Plain-language explanation of the methods used to produce and interpret BNR public statistics. |

The manuals overlap only where a handover between operational stages needs to be clear.

## Chapters

| Chapter | What it covers |
|---|---|
| **1. Analytics environment** | How Stata, private storage, public outputs, Quarto and GitHub fit together. |
| **2. Set up a workstation** | Software, repositories, local paths and system checks. |
| **3. Dashboard metrics** | Monthly REDCap extraction, shared analytical preparation, dashboard metrics, approval and publication. |
| **4. Tabulations** | Routine CVD tables, disclosure control, review, approval and publication. |
| **5. Briefings** | Routine and ad-hoc analytical briefing packages, including review, approval and publication. |
| **6. Mortality workflow** | Reserved for the mortality pathway when implementation is complete. |
| **7. Review an analytical release** | Common checks before any analytical release is approved. |
| **8. Disclosure control** | BNR small-number rules and human disclosure review. |
| **9. Approve and publish a release** | Common approval and promotion principles. |
| **10. Render and publish the website** | Local Quarto rendering, checking and deployment. |
| **11. Update website content** | Maintaining pages, briefings, listings, navigation and downloads. |
| **12. Make a safe code change** | Branch, edit, test, review and merge changes safely. |
| **13. Files, releases and versions** | Important locations, package identities and version conventions. |
| **14. Fix common problems** | Short symptom, cause and fix recipes. |
| **15. System reference** | Workflow, command, folder, file and terminology quick reference. |
